labels.rationale: Raw mode_i gates clk_a without low-phase storage. A mode transition during the high phase can create a runt or extra clock edge.
Unlatched unconstrained primary-input mode_i ANDs clk_a. A rising enable during the high phase creates a spurious clock edge. No low-phase latch or enable timing contract exists.
